card.name: Words in historical and military prose
card.fires_on: Common words in the middle of a noun phrase in older or historical web text, often military or farming, where a specific noun is expected next (e.g. 'of' before 'fertilizers', 'artillery' before 'officer').

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Small words like 'of', 'called' or 'my' just before a concrete noun in history or farming text.
modes.example: through the use<< of>> fertilizers was laid down.

modes.label: First part of a compound
modes.description: A noun that begins a compound or title, such as 'artillery', 'shell', 'bomb' or 'Post'.
modes.example: an accomplished and brave<< artillery>> officer, was mortally wounded

card.plain: It fires on words in old-style history and military or farming writing that sit just before the noun they set up.
evidence: through the use<< of>> fertilizers was laid down.
so I ordered<< my>> men to lie down
